title: "Multiple Linear Regression"
author: "Yeji Jeon"
format: html
---

```{r}
source("R/data_cleaned.R")

library(car)

head(pima_hmda_clean)

mlr_model <- lm(
  interest_rate ~ loan_term + income + loan_amount + property_value,
  data = pima_hmda_clean
)

summary(mlr_model)

vif_values <- vif(mlr_model)
print(vif_values)

```
